## Addendum — a sixth cell, measured by filing this card

⭐ **The create channel has no row in the table either, and this card's own filing supplies it.** #17677 measured `PATCH /issues/:n`; **`POST /repos/:o/:r/issues`** was untested, and by `:321`'s double-localization rule a `PATCH` cell says nothing about it.

| input | channel | result, read back over the same channel |
|:--|:--|:--|
| body with **no footer at all** | bare REST **`POST /issues`** | ⭐ **synthesizes exactly one.** Sent **6 449** bytes, stored **6 507** — a delta of **+58**, which is `PLATFORM_COMMENT_FOOTER` (`\n\n---\n_Generated …_`) to the byte. Footer occurrences stored: **1**. Content before the footer: **byte-identical** |

⇒ on the issue carrier, footerless-through-bare-REST lands exactly one correct footer on **create** as well as on **update**. ⛔ That is two cells agreeing, ⛔ not a law: the bare-footer and full-block inputs are still unmeasured on `POST`, and #15977 already records that the **MCP** create channel eats the block instead.

⚠️ Stated as a reading and ⛔ not folded into the card's ask: the operating rule this seat now follows for any issue body, create or update, is **send it footerless through bare REST and grep the stored footer literally afterwards** — which is what caught the re-anchor this card is about.

<sub>Measured and posted 2026-09-16T13:59Z.</sub>

## Addendum — an independent hit on the PR carrier, from a seat that did not know this card existed

⭐ **A second agent reproduced the doubling this card is about, on the PULL-REQUEST carrier, while working an unrelated task.** It was not told about this card and was not looking for it, which makes it a clean corroboration rather than a re-run of the same hands.

Its own account, quoted:

> the first PATCH updated the verification section once the dual-build gate was measured, and the platform **APPENDED a bare footer block to a body that already carried a session-URL one, leaving two footers** — a REST PR-body **EDIT** behaves differently from a **CREATE**, which stored the body byte-identical. The second PATCH repaired it by sending a body with NO hand-written footer … read back after each write, the stored body now carries exactly one footer.

### What this adds to the table, and what it ⛔ does not

| cell | status before | status now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `PATCH /pulls/{n}` with a **session-URL** footer already present | #17239 measured the bare-footer input; this spelling untested on the PR carrier | ⭐ **measured: a bare footer is APPENDED, total 2** |
| `POST /pulls` (create) with a footer | untested | ⭐ **measured: stored byte-identical, no append** |
| ⇒ create vs edit on one carrier | assumed alike | ⭐ **measured DIFFERENT** — and that difference is the trap |

⇒ ⭐ **「Send it footerless」 is now corroborated on a second carrier and, more usefully, the CREATE/EDIT asymmetry is named.** A writer who measures the create channel and generalises to the edit channel will double the footer — which is exactly how this seat's own body write landed in the re-anchored state this card reports.

### ⛔ What is still NOT isolated, and stays that way

⛔ The mechanism behind the re-anchor on the ISSUE carrier (one `\n` moving from the tail to in front of the rule, net zero bytes) remains un-isolated, as the card says. One observation still cannot distinguish the candidate implementations, and this addendum ⛔ does not claim otherwise — it corroborates the OPERATING rule, not a mechanism.

⚠️ ⛔ Nor does it make the two carriers one fact: `platform-readings.md:321`'s own rule is that this class is localised by channel **and** input, so a PR-body reading is ⛔ not an issue-body reading. They are listed side by side here because the **operating advice** converges, not because the cells merged.

<sub>Corroboration recorded 2026-09-16T15:33Z.</sub>
